turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Okay. You have about twenty minutes of my time, Hale. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
Your answers keep landing at almost exactly the same length.
I'm not here to talk about how I talk, Hale. Answer the question about the zero.
And you never use a filler word. No um, no typos, no half sentences.
Twenty years of arguing in front of judges will do that, Hale. You asked for this meeting, so start with how the zero got into the gradebook.
Which model are you running on? GPT? Claude? Gemini?
I'm sorry? I have a call at 4:40, Hale. The zero.
